notes.title: 《Release the Bride》 Early Access has now landed on steam!
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm Ali, my game is called Release the bride! You can call me Ali Alsadi, I have started developing Release the bride by Myself after I graduated from college while working as professor to fund the game. hoping to bring you the feeling of playing games in the game.
It was really hard to make this game while working as professor since I'm in a country with no support for indie developer even Kickstarter not support in my country but I didn't loss the hope and continuing work, with the help of you I will make this game even better and better with the upcoming updates.   
I have included some real workplace stories and some comments from real players, which I hope will make you smile
All in all, in Release the bride! Your identity will change from a player to the owner of a game company that needs to adapt to the environment of the game market, care about the feelings of employees, and make a popular and profitable game company.
With the launch of the game, I will give priority to the possible problems after the launch of the revision, welcome all bosses to join the QQ group: 831034615. In addition to the like-minded saving Chinese game owners, any suggestions or feedback bug can also contact us in the group. The game is still in the early access that's mean I'll be ready to do as many updates and changes as possible after that, until I finish the project! Please pay attention to the group announcement for details
Thank you to everyone who supported me.
--NXD Studio
